Upserted by slug. country_region_code is the HEADQUARTERS country (null = unresolved) and links to regions.json; headquarters_city, incorporation and operating_locations are separate facts. deployment_status is the company's HUMANOID deployment status (commercial_status enum verbatim) and deployment_note states what it rests on. is_public_company describes THIS entity only: true/false are sourced claims, null = unknown (never rendered as NO); a listed parent goes in parent_company/parent_listing/parent_relationship. Every evidence row names the profile fields it supports in claim_fields; db/validate_catalogue.py requires one for every asserted deployment_status, is_public_company and parent_company. Rows retrieved 2026-09-13 carry the docs/26 section 3.1 AGENT_ASSISTED_RESEARCH statement and verified_at null.

manufacturers.name: 1X Technologies
manufacturers.description: 1X Technologies develops humanoid robots for homes and workplaces. The company was originally founded as Halodi Robotics in 2014 and gives Palo Alto, California, as its headquarters. Its EVE is a wheeled humanoid used in industrial settings, and its current product, NEO, is a home humanoid. NEO is offered as a US$20,000 Early Access purchase or a US$499 monthly subscription. manufacturers.name: Agility Robotics
manufacturers.description: Agility Robotics, based in Salem, Oregon, builds Digit, a bipedal humanoid for material handling in logistics and manufacturing, such as moving totes. Digit is offered mainly as Robots-as-a-Service with a recurring subscription fee and is built at Agility's RoboFab facility in Salem. Agility has agreed to become a public company by merging with Churchill Capital Corp XI; the filing describes the transaction as proposed.

manufacturers.deployment_note: Digit is in live operations at customer sites including GXO and Schaeffler, and the vast majority of reported binding orders are structured as Robots-as-a-Service (SEC filing, 2026-06-24).

manufacturers.description: Unitree Robotics (宇树科技股份有限公司) was founded in 2016 by Wang Xingxing. It makes quadruped robots, including Go2 and the industrial B2, and humanoid robots, including G1, H1, H2 and R1, which it sells directly through its own online store. Applications cited by the company include power inspection, survey and exploration, public rescue, research, education and entertainment. Unitree's shares have been listed on the STAR Market of the Shanghai Stock Exchange since 19 August 2026.

manufacturers.name: XPeng Robotics
manufacturers.description: XPeng Robotics is the humanoid-robotics business of XPENG, a smart-mobility company with dual primary listings in New York and Hong Kong. Its IRON humanoid came off XPENG's new production line in September 2026, which the company described as a move from R&D prototyping to line manufacturing. XPENG plans mass production by the end of 2026, first rollouts in its own stores and campuses, and market launch and deliveries in China and overseas in 2027.
manufacturers.deployment_note: IRON: production line started in September 2026; mass production planned by the end of 2026 with initial rollouts in XPENG's own stores and campuses; external market launch and deliveries planned for 2027 (XPENG, 2026-09-08).
manufacturers.parent_relationship: XPeng Robotics is the robotics business of XPENG; it is not separately listed as a company in the sources reviewed.
